command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-specs.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-specs stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: Cited locations do not exist: `openspec/changes/fix-location-card-and-header-layout/specs/time-selection/spec.md` has 164 lines, yet R2 cites `specs/time-selection/spec.md:237-241` and `:246-255` in its Problem and Fix, R4's Location is `specs/time-selection/spec.md:243`, and the second Consistency bullet cites `:246-255`. The scenarios are actually at :125-129 ('Tracks in the 12-hour format fit narrow and wide screens'), :134-143 ('No horizontal scrolling') and the 'Wall-time input layout' requirement at :131-132.
R3 and the first Consistency bullet cite `specs/main-page/spec.md:102-112`, but that delta has 67 lines; the scenario 'No Add location button on an unreadable list' is at :56-66.

Freshness cites wrong lines for claims it marks ✅: `app/SettingsButton.tsx:72` (the `order-3 col-start-3 … justify-self-end` class is at :22) and `views/shared/LocalDateTime.tsx:67` (the outer span `flex shrink-0 flex-col items-end md:items-start` is at :45).

Missed WARNING: task 5.3 (`tasks.md:42`) says 'every time button and every hour label is one line high (box height at most the line height of a 24-hour label, and `scrollWidth <= clientWidth`)'. The time button in `LocalDateTime.tsx:52` is `min-h-11 … md:text-4xl`, at least 44 px high, while hour labels are `text-xs` in an `h-4` row (`DayTrack.tsx:127`). Taken literally, the FR5 one-line-time check cannot pass, so the implementer has to improvise the assertion. The review has no finding on this; the bound for the time button should be its own single line height.
